# Lattice

> > Lattice is an AI-powered HR platform that unifies performance management, compensation, engagement, and development to help managers and HR teams build stronger organizations.

Lattice provides a comprehensive people management platform that combines core HR functions with artificial intelligence capabilities. The platform serves HR teams and managers with tools for performance reviews, goal setting, compensation management, employee development, and real-time people analytics.

## Key Topics

- Performance Management
- Employee Engagement
- Talent Management
- HR Platform
- Compensation Management
- People Analytics
- Manager Tools
- Performance Reviews
- AI Features
- Goal Setting (OKRs)
- Succession Planning
- Employee Development
- One-on-One Meetings
- AI Agent
- Continuous Feedback

## Core Platform

- [Lattice | The HR platform that people love](https://lattice.com): Lattice HR and AI platform for managing people, pay, performance
- [Lattice People Platform](https://lattice.com/platform): AI-powered people platform for manager productivity and insights
- [Lattice AI: People First, AI-powered](https://lattice.com/ai): Lattice AI enhancements for managers and HR professionals
- [AI Agent for HR | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/ai-agent): AI Agent for instant HR answers, insights, and coaching

## Performance Management

- [Performance Management Software for HR Teams | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/performance): Performance management tools for reviews, accountability, habits
- [Performance Review Software | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/reviews): Performance review software for continuous employee achievement
- [Talent Reviews Software | Lattice People Management Platform](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/talent-reviews): Talent review software for succession planning and assessment
- [Performance Improvement Plans | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/pips): Structured PIPs for clarity, risk reduction, and improvement
- [Succession Planning | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/succession-planning): Succession planning for talent bench and leadership pipeline
- [One-on-One Meeting Software | Lattice People Management Platform](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/one-on-ones): 1:1 meeting software for manager-employee communication
- [Employee Updates | Lattice People Management Platform](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/updates): Real-time status updates for progress tracking and alignment
- [Employee Feedback Software | Lattice People Management Platform](https://lattice.com/platform/performance/feedback): Continuous feedback software with Slack and Teams integration

## Goals, Development & Growth

- [Employee Goal Management Software & OKRs | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/goals): Goal and OKR management for alignment and business results
- [Employee Development Plans & Growth Software | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/grow): AI-powered employee development with career paths
- [Habits Management Software | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/habits): Habits feature uniting 1:1s, updates, feedback for team alignment

## Compensation & Analytics

- [Compensation Management Software | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/compensation): Compensation management with benchmarking and analytics
- [HR Analytics Software | Lattice](https://lattice.com/platform/analytics): Real-time people analytics for insights and trend identification
